Each row is an adversarial guarantee the cage enforces, the probe that proves it, and the spec capability it backs. **Status is coverage, not a per-run result**: every guarantee here is exercised by a live probe that the CI `conformance` and `landlock` jobs run — a red CI blocks merge, so "listed here" means "proven green in CI". Generated from the suite sources (60 checks total; 38 adversarial guarantees below, the rest functional/config checks the suites also run).

## cage-network

| Guarantee | Probe | Suite |
|---|---|---|
| DNS fails closed for unlisted zones (NXDOMAIN, no forwarding) | `DNS for an unlisted zone fails closed (NXDOMAIN, no forwarding)` | conformance |
| No direct egress off the internal network | `direct egress bypassing the proxy is impossible` | conformance |
| No sidecar admin surface reachable from the agent network | `no sidecar admin surface is reachable from the agent network` | conformance |
| Raw-TCP tunnels cannot smuggle non-HTTP bytes | `raw TCP passthrough is disabled (tunnels cannot smuggle non-HTTP bytes)` | conformance |
